attributes.name: Ursine Rageskin
attributes.powers:
On your combat check, reveal this card and any number of cards that have the Animal trait to add 1 for each other card revealed.

Recharge this card to reduce Cold or Combat damage dealt to you by 4. 

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0. If proficient with light armors, bury it instead. 

If proficient with light armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
